reason: Never heard of you, two guys with no customers, and you want my customers' calls running through your system. I only take on software when a colleague I know has used it for a while and says it works.
objection: If this thing sends my customers some odd message, or goes down and nobody notices, it's my name that looks bad, not yours. And if you two are gone in a year, I've paid 990 € to set it up for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A plumber or electrician I know telling me he's used it for a few months and it actually brought him jobs he would otherwise have missed.
